messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your mailbox is almost full. 530MB 550MB IT Administrator helpdesk service will be working online today with Outlook Web App all faculty and staff are hereby advice to CLICK HERE<https://helpdeskservice1.godaddysites.com/> for increase their mailbox email quota to 25GB space.', 'Under quot;Know your Customer (KYC)quot; modulation Apple is cited by guidelines to carry out a validation of your information, omission to do so will result in cessation of your Apple ID within the next three days.', 'Your two incoming mails were placed on pending status due to the recent upgrade to our database, In order to receive the messages Click Here To Confirm Your Account.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.

{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
